title: ConfigError wraps String instead of structured fields
description: smtp/config.rs and reader/config.rs define ConfigError with variants Io(String), Parse(String), Validation(String) where the single field is a free-form error message string. Error variants that wrap String lose structure: callers who want to distinguish a validation error about a specific field from one about TLS config have to parse the string. Structured variants (e.g. Validation { field: &'static str, reason: String } or per-category variants) would let callers match without string parsing, and thiserror-derived Display would produce the same human-readable output. The String-wrapping pattern is acceptable in application glue code, but here it is duplicated in two separate config modules with identical structure — a shared error type with thiserror would eliminate the duplication.
